description: This file defines classes and constants for managing Chromium protocol connections and sessions within Playwright, including CRConnection, CRSession, and CDPSession classes, handling message passing, session management, and event handling.

classes.name: CRConnection
classes.description: Manages a connection to the Chromium remote debugging protocol, handling message sending, receiving, and session management.

classes.name: CRSession
classes.description: Represents a session within a CRConnection, allowing command sending, message handling, and session lifecycle management.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: A specialized session for Chrome DevTools Protocol interactions, supporting event handling and target attachment.

methods.name: _rawSend
methods.description: Sends a protocol message with a session ID, method, and parameters, returning the message ID.

methods.name: _onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming protocol responses, routing them to the appropriate session.

methods.name: _onClose
methods.description: Handles connection closure, cleaning up sessions and emitting a disconnect event.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the transport connection if not already closed.

methods.name: createBrowserSession
methods.description: Creates a new browser target session.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a protocol command within a session.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the session from its target.

methods.name: attachToTarget
methods.description: Attaches to a specific target and returns a new CDPSession.
